notes.title: Letters 2026
notes.body:
Whoever is helping me with letters: keep this note current when anything changes.

All three due Tue Dec 1, 2026, 5:00 pm ET. Each program emails me a status note when a letter arrives.

Kestrel Postdoctoral Fellowship
  Writers: Daniel Okafor, Sven Halvorsen
  Letter upload link (any writer): https://kestrel-fellowship.example.org/letters/KF27-0412
Northfield Foundation Fellowship
  Writers: Daniel Okafor, Sven Halvorsen
  Letter upload link (any writer): https://northfield-foundation.example.org/recommend/NF27-1187
Vireo Fellowship
  Writers: Daniel Okafor, Sven Halvorsen
  Letter upload link (any writer): https://vireo-fellowship.example.org/letters/VF27-5531

Backup: Ingrid (Sep 12) — OK to ask her directly if anyone falls through, no need to check with me.
